description: Implementation of QR Code segment handling, including segment creation, mode management, and data encoding for QR code generation.

classes.name: QrSegment
classes.description: Represents a segment of data in a QR code, including its mode, character count, and encoded data.

classes.name: QrSegment::Mode
classes.description: Defines the encoding mode for a QR segment, including mode bits and character count bits per version.

methods.name: makeBytes
methods.description: Creates a QR segment from raw byte data.

methods.name: makeNumeric
methods.description: Creates a QR segment from a numeric string.

methods.name: makeAlphanumeric
methods.description: Creates a QR segment from an alphanumeric string.

methods.name: makeEci
methods.description: Creates a QR segment for ECI (Extended Channel Interpretation) assignment.

methods.name: getTotalBits
methods.description: Calculates total bits required for a list of segments at a specific QR code version.

methods.name: isAlphanumeric
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only characters encodable in alphanumeric mode.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only numeric characters.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Returns the encoding mode of the segment.

methods.name: getNumChars
methods.description: Returns the number of characters in the segment.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the encoded data of the segment.
